messages.content:
The SQL query appears to be correct and does not contain any of the common mistakes listed. Here's the query again for clarity:

```sql
SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalAmount 
FROM Customer c 
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId 
GROUP BY c.CustomerId 
ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC, c.CustomerId ASC 
LIMIT 5;
```
